summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of the first tranche of its 2026 treasury share buyback program and the launch of a second tranche. Under the first tranche (ended 22 May 2026), Eni purchased ~5.1M shares (0.17% of capital) for ~€119.9M at an average ~€23.76. The second tranche authorizes buybacks of up to ~297.9M shares (~9.8% of capital) through April 2027, valued at up to €2.8B (expandable to €4B). Shares acquired in the second tranche will be cancelled (capital reduction) as additional shareholder remuneration. Purchases on Euronext Milan via independent agent; daily details disclosed. This is a structural return-of-capital initiative; watch execution pace and cancellation impact on per-share metrics.
